These shares of common stock (the "Shares") of NC SLF Inc. (the "Issuer") are owned directly by the UAW Chrysler Retirees Medical Benefits Plan, as established and maintained
by the UAW Chrysler Retirees Employees' Beneficiary Association, an employee organization within the meaning of Section 3(4) of the Employee Retirement Income Security
Act of 1974, as amended ("ERISA") under the UAW Retiree Medical Benefits Trust, organized as a 501(c)(9) Voluntary Employee Beneficiary Association (the "UAW RMBT").
